name: securelint-ai
description: SecureLint AI - root dev runner (backend + frontend dalam satu perintah)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix client run typecheck
